title.narrative: DIPD 2026-2030: Strengthening the Danish democracy support through partnerships

description.narrative: This project will contribute to DIPD’s vision of a world where political parties are well-founded democratic organisations that represent the social, economic and political interests of citizens, and contribute to policy development in well-functioning and reliable multiparty democracies. Four main outcomes are envisaged: 1. Political parties and other political actors contribute to policy development that addresses significant societal challenges and represents the interests and rights of their voters and members. 2. Political parties and other political actors implement initiatives that contribute to democratic organisational structures that ensure inclusion, equity and representation of members and voters, locally and nationally. 3. Political actors engage in multiparty cooperation and participate in dialogue between parties, social movements, free media and NGOs contributing to political development and creating a foundation for a multiparty democracy. 4. DIPD contributes to knowledge-sharing and is making results available for the public

title.narrative: Outcome 2: Political parties and other political actors implement initiatives that contribute to democratic organisational structures that ensure inclusion, equality and representation of members and voters, locally and nationally.

Number and description of cases where political parties and other political actors implement initiatives that contribute to democratic organisational structures which ensure inclusion, equality and representation of members and voters, locally and nationally.

target.value: Engagement partners have formulated how they intend to implement and contribute to change within strategic objective 2 through partnerships, building inclusive, representative and democratic organisations. 50% of active partnerships working with democratic party structures and/or political culture have developed concrete plans for capacity development that will allow political parties to develop initiatives that contribute to more transparent democratic party structures and/or support a political culture that fosters equal participation and broad representation in the party organisation. 50% of active partnerships working with representation have developed concrete plans for capacity development that will allow political parties and other actors to develop strategies and structures that strengthen representation of underrepresented groups.

50% of active partnerships working with democratic party structures and/or political culture have initiated actions that will allow political parties to develop initiatives that contribute to more transparent democratic party structures and/or support a political culture that fosters equal participation and broad representation in the party organisation. 50% of active partnerships working with representation have initiated actions that will allow political parties and other actors to develop strategies and structures that strengthen representation of underrepresented groups.

75% of active partnerships working with democratic party structures and/or political culture have initiated actions that will allow political parties to develop initiatives that contribute to more transparent democratic party structures and/or support a political culture that fosters equal participation and broad representation in the party organisation. 75% of active partnerships working with representation have initiated actions that will allow political parties and other actors to develop strategies and structures that strengthen representation of underrepresented groups.

50% of active partnerships working with democratic party structures and/or political culture have implemented actions that allow political parties to implement initiatives that contribute to more transparent democratic party structures and/or support a political culture that fosters equal participation and broad representation in the party organisation. 50% of active partnerships working with representation have implemented actions that allow political parties and other actors to implement strategies and structures that strengthen representation of underrepresented groups.

80% of active partnerships working with democratic party structures and/or political culture have completed implementation of actions that have contributed to political parties development and implementation of more transparent democratic party structures and/or a political culture that fosters equal participation and broad representation in the party organisation. 80% of active partnerships working with representation have completed implementation of actions that have contributed to political parties and other actors implementing strategies and structures that strengthen representation of underrepresented groups. DIPD has carried out at least one cross-cutting evaluation of the work contributing to strategic objective 2 implemented by EPs and partners. The evaluation contributes to learning in DIPD, EPs and local partners and improves the understanding of barriers and drivers to change and application of methodologies and best practices. 100% of active partnerships have documented how partnerships have contributed to change within outcome 2, including collection and documentation of best practices, lessons learned, and effects of partnership interventions related to enhancing democratic organisational structures that ensure inclusion, equality and representation of members and voters, locally and nationally.
